domain.description: A domain the store owns, such as loja-do-joao.com.br.

slug.description: The label under the platform's domain, such as loja-do-joao.

adapter.description: One of the adapters this deployment composed.

label.description: What to recognise this connection by.

secret.description: The credential. Stored encrypted and never returned.

cursor.description: Where the last sync stopped, as the adapter wrote it.

health.description: What the last check found. An observation, not a promise.

label.description: What to recognise these settings by.

settings.description: Field name to value. Merged into what is stored; unknown fields are refused.

kind.description: A secret is stored encrypted and never returned.

capability.description: The port this adapter serves: notifications, shipping or search.

store_scoped.description: Whether a store may hold its own settings, or only the platform.

missing.description: Required fields still to be filled. A connector missing anything is not used.

secrets_set.description: The secret fields that hold a value. Their values are never returned.

settings.description: The settings that are not secret, as they were registered.

store_id.description: Absent for the platform's own settings.

usable.description: Whether the platform will build an adapter from these settings: enabled and complete.

body.description: Text with {{snake_case}} placeholders; nothing else is interpreted.

category.description: Marketing deliveries are blocked until DEC-PRIV-003 defines consent.

history.description: Present when reading a single delivery.

location.description: Where the error occurred, such as body.name or query.limit.

serving.description: Whether the edge answers on this name.

verification_token.description: Publish as a TXT record on _sellvex-challenge.<domain>.

adapters.description: What this deployment can connect to.

status.description: Always ok while the process can serve requests.

variables.description: Placeholders the text uses; every delivery must supply them.

request_id.description: Request identifier for support and tracing.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

status.description: ready when every dependency is up.

recipient.description: The address on the channel. Never echoed back in full.

variables.description: One value per placeholder of the template.

cell_id.description: Present once the store is placed.

paused.description: The merchant closed its own shop.

selling.description: Whether the store may take new orders. Both conditions must be clear.

suspended.description: The platform stopped this store. Only the platform lifts it.

bearer.description: Access token from the approved OpenID Connect provider.

get.description: Reports that the process can serve requests. Does not probe dependencies.
Probes every configured dependency. Returns 503 when any dependency is down.

503.description: One or more dependencies are down.

patch.description: Corrects what was typed wrong at registration. Country, currency and home region cannot be changed: they decide which cell serves the store and how its money is counted.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: How this store configured its own connectors. A connector absent here is served by the platform's settings, so an empty list means the store uses the platform's.

delete.description: Deletes this store's own settings and their secrets, after which the platform's apply again.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

put.description: Registers or changes this store's own settings for a connector, which take precedence over the platform's. Settings are merged; secrets are encrypted at rest and never returned. Requires an authentication in the last 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Stops using this store's own settings, which falls back to the platform's rather than to nothing.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Starts using this store's own settings again.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: The names this store answers on, with the state of each. A pending domain carries the token to publish in DNS.

post.description: Registers a domain this store owns. It serves nothing until possession is proved: publish the returned token as a TXT record, then verify.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Takes <slug>.<platform domain> for this store. The platform owns the zone, so the name is served at once. A reserved word or a name another store holds is refused.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

delete.description: Stops serving the name and frees it for another store to claim.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Checks that the domain carries its token in DNS, or already points at the platform. Possession is re-checked afterwards too: a domain that stops pointing here stops being served.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: What this store is connected to, with the health of each and what this deployment can connect to. Credentials are never returned.

post.description: Opens a connection to one of the composed adapters. The credential is encrypted at rest and never returned. A store has one live connection per adapter. Requires an authentication in the last 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: One connection, with its health and where its last sync stopped.

post.description: Removes the credential and stops the connection. Its record stays, so a past sync is still explainable; reconnecting needs a new credential.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Stops using the connection without losing where its sync stopped.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Starts using a paused connection again, from where it stopped.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

put.description: An opt-out per category, honoured on every later request whatever DEC-PRIV-003 decides about consent.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: A new version of the template with this key, channel and locale. Versions are immutable; a delivery names the version it rendered.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Renders the latest version of the template for the recipient and queues it; the Idempotency-Key is the request key, so a retry never sends twice. An opted-out recipient yields a suppressed delivery; a marketing template is blocked until DEC-PRIV-003.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.summary: Get a delivery with its attempts

post.description: The merchant closes its own shop: a holiday, an empty warehouse. It sells nothing until the merchant lifts it.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Lifts the merchant's own pause. A store the platform suspended stays closed and says so, rather than reporting success to a merchant who would then believe the shop is open.

parameters.description: Unique key for this mutation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
